narr: Severe thunderstorms produced large hail across parts of Elbert and Lincoln counties, along with one brief tornado. The hail ranged from quarter to around tennis ball size. Some of the roadways were completely covered by several inches of hail accumulation. The tornado touched down in an open field with no damage observed. Localized flash flooding was observed near Boyero.
ev: Floodwaters of unknown depth caused a single vehicle crash along U.S Highway 287 east of Boyero.
lsr: Running water over roadway. Unknown depth. Caused crash. Report via Twitter.
